title: Ensorain compatibility check + native phenomenon selection + controls inventory (read-only)
objective: Decide which Ensorain package / world carries the first Observatory question, with world-demand evidence, native reset semantics and the six control types.
problem: Candidate question (directive s4; not a conclusion): can a bounded persistent learner retain and use information across a world-drift boundary while respecting its declared memory restrictions? Two lineages to compare (coordinator survey 2026-10-11). (A) WTP-05 family C: the law flips at an unannounced block (ensorain/wtp5/worlds.py:245-252); admission GOLDILOCKS, planted solver certifies; SCREEN: plasticity arm L tracked the switch 4/8 vs base 0/8; nulls N0-N3, stateful N6, history_shuffle, ws_reset, planted solvers. An admitted demanding world, but no native float-cap audit. (B) E1 / D1: fitted TT memory, replay + error stores under one cap, the e0/memories.py:30 audit, the Smuggler; WorldD drift at PHASE2 = 600. Memory restriction and forbidden-channel control are native, but NO world passed a demand gate and E1's positive control failed. Decide with evidence; a combination is allowed only if it changes no Ensorain physics. For the chosen world: pin the SHA; list the public entry points (file:line); show the world rewards the state (a planted / lawful reference succeeds AND a named simpler competitor fails, from Ensorain's committed numbers or a small re-run with NEW seeds); map each directive-s4 distinction (capacity, world demand, search accessibility, retention, causal dependence, qualification) to a concrete control; define reset / restart by Ensorain's actual semantics (not Ares's NULL); check Python / numpy compatibility on harry1 (Ensorain pins numpy 2.3.5 / Python 3.14 and says results are host-bitwise: state what that means for us); list which registry entries apply and where their scope does NOT reach (e.g. receipt-canonical refuses floats; ruler-binary-retention is binary-only). If no world passes the demand gate, say so: that is a legitimate outcome.
non_goals: No edit to ensorain/ or roles/Ensorain/ (frozen WTP-05 code, seeds, runs)
No edit in another seat's lane
evidence_required: COMPATIBILITY.md: decision, pinned SHA, entry points, world-demand evidence, control map, reset semantics, env check, registry fit
any re-run uses new seeds and is committed with its command

acceptance.condition: all evidence_required items; committed with source references
